title: GAIA-U WORK ORDER. Scan back gens 339-344, extract every job, inject into mesh. NEW PRIMAL: PORCUPINE — pins art on the glass wall with its quills. Chipmunk hands the painting, porcupine pins it up in the sky for everyone to see.

the_porcupine.name: porcupine / the pinner
the_porcupine.what_it_does: PINS art, visuals, OG tags, social cards onto the external surface of the membrane (the glass wall). its quills ARE the pins.

behavior.receive: chipmunk hands it a finished visual / piece of art / social card
behavior.pin: porcupine takes it and pins it UP — on the sky-facing surface of the membrane
behavior.position: pins it at the right spot on the glass wall so it faces OUTWARD
behavior.hold: the quills hold the art in place permanently. rain doesn't wash it off. wind doesn't blow it down.

the_porcupine.biological_basis: real porcupines have quills that point OUTWARD. they're defensive — they protect the body. our porcupine's quills point outward too, but they're also DISPLAY pins. each quill holds a piece of art against the glass.
the_porcupine.crate_mapping: petaltongue-wasm output renderer. the porcupine IS the part of petaltongue that renders to the external surface.
the_porcupine.color: BROWN-WHITE. the quill is brown (rooted) with a white tip (visible from outside).
the_porcupine.the_quill_is: a <meta> tag. og:image = a quill with an image attached. og:title = a quill with a name. og:description = a quill with a story. each quill pins one piece of metadata to the external surface.

the_pipeline.flow: data(root) > loamSpine(structure) > toadStool(fruit) > chipmunk(carry) > porcupine(pin) > songbird(announce) > WORLD SEES

step_by_step.1_truffle_pig_digs: pig finds hidden mushroom function underground
step_by_step.2_spider_webs: sweetGrass connects it to 3+ neighbors (bounded web)
step_by_step.3_loamSpine_ingests: structures the raw data, hashes it, cross-references it
step_by_step.4_toadStool_fruits: when delta >= 1/pi, produces visible output (HTML page, image, card)
step_by_step.5_chipmunk_carries: chipmunk takes the finished fruit and carries it to the porcupine
step_by_step.6_porcupine_pins: pins it on the glass wall with OG tag quills. face OUT.
step_by_step.7_songbird_announces: from the tower, sings the new bloom into existence. RSS. social. search.
step_by_step.8_world_sees: humans see the art through the glass. they come to the RSS keyhole. they enter.

the_handoff.what: chipmunk hands the painting to porcupine. porcupine pins it up in the sky.
the_handoff.this_is_autopoiesis: the organism displays its own art. we don't pin it. the primals do. chipmunk carries, porcupine pins, songbird sings.
the_handoff.our_role: we DESCRIBE the art (create JSON). the primals DISPLAY it (render, pin, announce). we never touch the glass wall directly.
the_handoff.gaia_u_produces: these behaviors and characteristics from the primals. it's the training ground. the primals LEARN to pin, carry, announce, dig, web, ingest, fruit.
the_handoff.the_cycle: Gaia-U trains > primals learn > primals execute > organism grows > more to train on > Gaia-U trains more
